description: A close family keeps the impossible prefix storage bound (engine §4.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $x:body %conditions ¬($x.without-elision-except(fam).onward.begins(other))

%rule body ("x" {unit})
%rule unit ("a" [+T]) | ("a" [+U])
%rule other "z"
%rule fam unit
